Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `lib/scatterlist.c`**
- The function `sg_miter_get_next_page` was modified to ensure that the `__offset` and `sg_pgoffset` fields are correctly adjusted.
- The line that sets `miter->__offset` was changed to use `miter->piter.sg_pgoffset` instead of the previous variable.
- The `sg_pgoffset` is now incremented by the value of `miter->__offset` shifted right by `PAGE_SHIFT`.
- The calculation for `miter->__remaining` was updated to use the new `sg_pgoffset` and `__offset` values, ensuring that the remaining bytes are calculated correctly.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `lib/scatterlist.c` are interrelated as they collectively address the issue of handling cases where `sg->offset` exceeds `PAGE_SIZE`. By adjusting the `__offset` and `sg_pgoffset`, the patch ensures that the mapping iterator logic remains valid and that data can be properly copied into the buffer without exceeding the kmapped area. This fix is crucial for maintaining the integrity of data access in scenarios where the scatter-gather list items span multiple pages.

Here is the commit message:
lib/scatterlist: Fix mapping iterator when sg->offset is
 greater than PAGE_SIZE

All mapping iterator logic is based on the assumption that sg->offset
is always lower than PAGE_SIZE.

But there are situations where sg->offset is such that the SG item
is on the second page. In that case sg_copy_to_buffer() fails
properly copying the data into the buffer. One of the reason is
that the data will be outside the kmapped area used to access that
data.

This patch fixes the issue by adjusting the mapping iterator
offset and pgoffset fields such that offset is always lower than
PAGE_SIZE.

Signed-off-by: Christophe Leroy <christophe.leroy@c-s.fr>
Fixes: 4225fc8555a9 ("lib/scatterlist: use page iterator in the mapping iterator")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

Here is the root cause:
The bug occurs because the mapping iterator logic incorrectly assumes that the `sg->offset` is always less than `PAGE_SIZE`. When `sg->offset` exceeds `PAGE_SIZE`, it leads to improper calculations in the mapping iterator, causing `sg_copy_to_buffer()` to fail as it attempts to access data outside the kmapped area.

Here is the patch:
 
 static bool sg_miter_get_next_page(struct sg_mapping_iter *miter)
 {
 	if (!miter->__remaining) {
 		struct scatterlist *sg;
-		unsigned long pgoffset;
 
 		if (!__sg_page_iter_next(&miter->piter))
 			return false;
 
 		sg = miter->piter.sg;
-		pgoffset = miter->piter.sg_pgoffset;
 
-		miter->__offset = pgoffset ? 0 : sg->offset;
+		miter->__offset = miter->piter.sg_pgoffset ? 0 : sg->offset;
+		miter->piter.sg_pgoffset += miter->__offset >> PAGE_SHIFT;
+		miter->__offset &= PAGE_SIZE - 1;
 		miter->__remaining = sg->offset + sg->length -
-				(pgoffset << PAGE_SHIFT) - miter->__offset;
+				     (miter->piter.sg_pgoffset << PAGE_SHIFT) -
+				     miter->__offset;
 		miter->__remaining = min_t(unsigned long, miter->__remaining,
 					   PAGE_SIZE - miter->__offset);
 	}
 
 	return true;
 }
